The Employment Tribunals Extension of Jurisdiction (Amendment) (Scotland) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Employment Tribunals Extension of Jurisdiction (Scotland) Order 1994 (“the 1994 Order”). Article 2 amends article 7 of the 1994 Order to extend the time limit for bringing proceedings before an employment tribunal in Scotland, in respect of employees’ contract of employment claims, from three months to six months. The Employment Tribunals (Early Conciliation: Exemptions and Rules of Procedure) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Employment Tribunals (Early Conciliation: Exemptions and Rules of Procedure) Regulations 2014 (“the 2014 Regulations”) to add to the information that prospective claimants must provide to ACAS in order to comply with the requirement to contact ACAS before instituting proceedings in section 18A of the Employment Tribunals Act 1996. These Regulations also clarify the 2014 Regulations and make further provision regarding the early conciliation procedure.

title: The International Controlled Transaction Reporting Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in connection with the provision of information in relation to international controlled transactions.

summary: These Regulations are made under the Seafarers (Wages and Working Conditions) Act 2023 (c. 8) (“the Act”).

Correction Slip
summary: These Regulations amend the Ministry of Defence Police (Conduct, Performance and Appeals Tribunals) Regulations 2020 (S.I. 2020/1087) (“the 2020 Regulations”), primarily to align with changes made by the Police (Conduct, Performance and Complaints and Misconduct) (Amendment) Regulations 2025 (S.I. 2025/558) to the disciplinary procedures that apply to members and former members of the territorial police forces in England and Wales and appeals from those procedures.

title: Correction Slip
summary: These Regulations bring into force a number of the provisions of the Housing (Scotland) Act 2025 (“the Act”) on 1 April 2026, 1 August 2026, 6 October 2026 and 1 April 2027.

title: The Financial Services (Gibraltar) (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations extend by 12 months the transitional arrangements under Parts 2 and 3 of the Financial Services (Gibraltar) (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (S.I. 2019/589) which enable specified categories of Gibraltar-based firms to provide financial services in the United Kingdom and facilitate the access by similar types of UK-based firms to Gibraltar’s financial services market.

title: The Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force specified provisions of the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (c. 20) (“the 2026 Act”). These are the fifth commencement regulations made under the 2026 Act.

title: The Export Control (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Export Control Order 2008 (S.I. 2008/3231) (“the 2008 Order”) and assimilated Council Regulation (EC) No 428/2009 of 5 May 2009 setting up a Community regime for the control of exports, transfer, brokering and transit of dual-use items (Recast) (EUR 2009/428) (“the assimilated Dual-Use Regulation”).

summary: These Regulations specify types of persons as an approved person for the purposes of section 123D of and paragraph 4(7) of Schedule 9A to the Transport Act 2000 (c. 38). summary: These Regulations relate to the levy arrangements that support the Contracts for Difference scheme established under Chapter 2 of Part 2 of the Energy Act 2013 (c. 32) (“the 2013 Act”). title: The Control of Asbestos (Amendment etc.) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 (S.I. 2012/632) (“the 2012 Regulations”) to introduce a requirement that the assessment of the cleanliness of the premises, where work relating to asbestos has been carried out, is undertaken by a person who is appointed independently of the person who carried out the work relating to asbestos on those premises.

title: The Customs (Tariff and Miscellaneous Amendments) (No. 7) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulation 2 amends the definition of “the authorised use document” in regulation 32(2) of the Customs (Special Procedures and Outward Processing) (EU Exit) Regulations 2018 (S.I. 2018/1249) to refer to a new version of that document. title: The Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (Commencement No. 5) and English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the fifth commencement regulations made under the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (c. 34) (“the 2025 Act”) and the fifth commencement regulations made under the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (c. 23) (“the 2026 Act”). These Regulations bring into force provisions relating to spatial development strategies.

title: The Data-gathering (Ongoing Data: Interest and Payment Card Transactions) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision requiring persons of specified description to provide specified data to His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs (“HMRC”) on an ongoing basis.
